newsitem.title: UK: BA drops cargo fuel surcharge from midnight.
newsitem.headline: BA drops cargo fuel surcharge from midnight.

text.p: British Airways said it is removing its ex-UK air cargo fuel surcharge with effect from midnight tonight, April 16.
BA imposed its surcharges of six pence per kg on intercontinental and three pence per kg on European and domestic UK routes from November 8.

The move brings the British carrier into line with other major airlines who have in recent days been systematically announcing the withdrawal of the surcharge,imposed last November due to sharply higher jet fuel prices. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
